Count triples of positions i<j<k whose values form the pattern where π(i) is largest, π(j) smallest, π(k) middle (pattern 312). For each choice of 3 positions, exactly one of the 3! = 6 relative orders of the values gives this pattern, so each triple contributes 1/6 of the time.

Total = C(10,3) · 10!/6 = 120 · 3628800/6 = 120 · 604800 = 72,576,000.

ANSWER: 72576000
